result.title: ALIVE: Making Streaming Video Models Interactive
result.summary: Streaming video LLMs can continuously observe the world, yet often handle user requests in isolation. We introduce ALIVE, an interactive streaming video model supporting proactive monitoring, streaming task coordination, and feedback-seeking interaction. We construct ALIVE-SFT-288K and ALIVE-RL-3K for two-stage training. Contrastive supervised fine-tuning teaches when and how to respond, while reinforcement learning with Behavior-Aligned Credit Assignment (BACA) combines trajectory-level and local advantages to refine decisions, responses, and silence across multi-turn interactions. We also introduce FSI-Bench to evaluate feedback seeking and subsequent task completion. ALIVE achieves the highest overall scores among the compared models on four public benchmarks and FSI-Bench, demonstrating strong streaming understanding and interactive capabilities.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ALIVE，一个支持主动监控、流式任务协调与反馈寻求的交互式流式视频模型：先用对比式监督微调教模型「何时、如何」回应，再用结合轨迹级与局部优势的行为对齐信用分配（BACA）强化学习，细化多轮交互中的决策、回应与沉默，并构建 FSI-Bench 评测反馈寻求及后续任务完成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时回应／何时沉默」的决策与轨迹级加局部的信用分配，可能为 LVR 的停止决策和 latent 轨迹贡献分配提供可核查线索；但研究对象是流式视频交互策略而非内部视觉推理状态，迁移需较多核查。
